label: FY2019-H1 2022 半导体塑料封装压机 (manual molding press) revenue/units/price
definition: Source-native 2019-2021 annual and H1 2022 interim rows for Naike's '半导体塑料封装压机' (manual plastic packaging press, 450-ton and 250-ton hydraulically driven models per naike_annual_2022 p17), from the IPO prospectus's model-level sales breakdown (naike_ipo_2022, physical p247). Carried at molding_transfer, not at the molding parent: the prospectus's own comparison of the two machines (physical pp125-126) states that the manual press performs the encapsulation step 合模注塑→开模 -- the identical phrase it uses for the automatic press's 封装 step -- and gives its clamping range as 250T-450T, matching the model names. The two differ in automation and in the ancillary machines a manual line needs, not in mechanism, and molding_transfer's own scope note admits manual as well as automatic transfer presses. An earlier version of this record sat at the parent on the grounds that no mechanism was named; that was read off a short product blurb rather than off the prospectus's dedicated comparison section. Partitions the broader '半导体封装设备' product line; excludes the 120-ton and 180-ton automatic lines and trim-and-form equipment, reported separately in the same table.

label: FY2022-FY2025 半导体封装设备 (combined packaging-equipment basket) revenue/units/margin
definition: Naike's '半导体封装设备' main-business product-line row from each annual report's 主营业务分产品情况 table (FY2022: naike_annual_2022 p38; FY2023: naike_annual_2023 p38; FY2024: naike_annual_2024 p39; FY2025: naike_annual_2025 p38). From FY2022 the annual reports stop giving the model-level split the IPO prospectus gave for 2019-2021/H1 2022 (verified: no 120-ton/180-ton/manual-press/trim-and-form breakdown found in any of the four annual reports' MD&A or notes); the issuer's own prospectus (naike_ipo_2022 p139) states this product line's own composition is '半导体全自动塑料封装设备、半导体全自动切筋成型设备以及半导体手动塑封压机' -- fully automatic transfer-molding equipment (120/180-ton, from FY2024 also the next-generation NTAMS180-X1), fully automatic trim-and-form equipment, and manual molding presses, combined and not split in this line. Trim-and-form is not a molding process, so this basket mixes a molding-equipment category with a non-molding one and cannot be allocated; it is filed at multi_equipment, never at molding or any molding child. Excludes '半导体封装模具' (packaging molds/tooling), reported as its own separate line in the same table and out of scope for this packet (tooling, not equipment).
